title: Drishyam 3 Earns $6.71 Million in North America, Beating Drishyam 2 by 81 Percent
excerpt: Koimoi puts the Ajay Devgn thriller at $6.71 million (Rs 63.88 crore) in the US and Canada after 26 days, 81.35 percent above Drishyam 2's lifetime $3.7 million and a North American career best for Devgn.
body:
• Drishyam 3 has grossed $6.71 million (Rs 63.88 crore) in North America in 26 days, according to Koimoi.
  • That is 81.35 percent more than Drishyam 2's North American lifetime collection of $3.7 million, a difference of $3.01 million.
  • The total makes Drishyam 3 Ajay Devgn's highest-grossing film in North America, ahead of Singham Again at $4.6 million.
  • Sacnilk reported the film had already crossed $5.04 million by its second Saturday, making it the second-highest-grossing Bollywood film of 2026 in the territory behind Dhurandhar 2.

Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3: The Conclusion has grossed $6.71 million at the North American box office in 26 days, according to Koimoi, earning 81.35 percent more in the United States and Canada than Drishyam 2 managed in its entire run. Koimoi put the rupee equivalent at Rs 63.88 crore and said the film added $23,000 on its fourth Tuesday, day 26, as collections slowed late in the run.

The comparison with the previous film is the core of the result. Drishyam 2 closed in North America with a lifetime collection of $3.7 million, itself a good performance for the territory. Drishyam 3 has beaten that by $3.01 million, taking the franchise's North American performance, in Koimoi's assessment, to a different level from its predecessor.

Devgn's biggest film in the territory

The $6.71 million total also resets Ajay Devgn's own record in North America. Koimoi's ranking of the actor's top grossers in the territory puts Drishyam 3 first, ahead of Singham Again at $4.6 million and Drishyam 2 at $3.7 million, followed by Golmaal Again at $2.36 million and Shaitaan at $2.29 million. The margin over Singham Again, an action franchise title, is notable because Drishyam 3 is a crime thriller without a conventional action spectacle at its centre.

The film is directed by Abhishek Pathak and produced by Kumar Mangat Pathak, Abhishek Pathak, Ajit Andhare and Alok Jain under Panorama Studios and Star Studio18, according to Koimoi. Alongside Devgn as Vijay Salgaonkar, it stars Jaideep Ahlawat, Tabu, Rajat Kapoor, Kamlesh Sawant, Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav and Prakash Raj. It was released theatrically on October 2, 2026.

How the run was built

The North American total was not a late surge. Sacnilk reported that the film collected approximately $515,000 on Saturday, October 10, taking its cumulative North America gross to $5.04 million inside its first nine days. At that point it was already the second-highest-grossing Bollywood film of 2026 in North America, behind Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge, which Sacnilk's leaderboard put at $28.60 million.

That early pace matters for reading the final figure. A thriller that crosses $5 million in nine days in the United States and Canada is drawing repeat and word-of-mouth audiences, not only opening-weekend franchise loyalists. The subsequent climb from $5.04 million to $6.71 million came at a slower rate, consistent with Koimoi's day-26 figure of $23,000, but it was enough to widen the lead over both its predecessor and Devgn's previous best.

What it means for diaspora audiences

For Indian audiences in the United States and Canada, the result is a data point against the assumption that only large-scale event films travel overseas. Drishyam 3 is the closing chapter of a Hindi thriller trilogy built around one character, Vijay Salgaonkar, and it has out-earned every other Ajay Devgn release in the territory, including his action titles. Its North American gross is also a substantial share of the film's overseas performance, which trackers had earlier placed in the Rs 130 crore to Rs 143 crore range worldwide outside India.

What remains in the run

One benchmark is still out of reach. On Sacnilk's all-time Bollywood leaderboard for North America, tenth place sits above $8 million, so even at $6.71 million Drishyam 3 remains outside the all-time top 10, and Sacnilk cautioned that reaching that level would require a substantial extension of the run. With day-26 collections down to $23,000, the film's remaining North American business is likely to be incremental. Its records in the territory, the franchise comparison and Devgn's personal best, are already set.
